propositions: CLI write-command argument parsing uses hand-rolled loops with bespoke semantics (--assignee absent=None sentinel, explicit ""=clear; --force with following-token consumption) that should be replaced with stdlib argparse while preserving exact behavior
argparse parser must silently skip unknown tokens, reject abbreviated flags, and exit 1 (not 2) on value-less/invalid-flag errors with historical messages, not argparse defaults

--force semantics differ by command: claim bare --force consumes next non-option token or defaults to "(no reason given)"; transition bare --force sets force_reason="" (None only when absent) and never consumes following token
--assignee must preserve None-vs-empty-string distinction: absent→None (triggers default fallback), explicit empty string→clear, and value-less at end→exit 1

transition._parse_flags must be retained as argparse-backed shim returning identical 5-tuple for three external direct callers (test_close_ref_target_80af, test_transition_force_flag_24f7, test_dependency_audit)
--help output remains byte-exact from dispatcher-served goldens (help/claim.txt, help/transition.txt); parser is parse-only with add_help=False
